contract: MCP servers do the craft; the brain records the knowledge. The brain never installs a server or touches a credential — it only recognizes ones the curator already connected (or is offered and chooses to connect) and knows which .brain/ folder their output belongs in. Same contract as recommended-plugins.json, extended from Claude Code plugins to MCP servers.

install.how: The brain never runs setup for you. Each entry's setup_hint is an instructions-only `claude mcp add ...` template with an env-var placeholder for any credential — confirm the exact command and fill in your own token before running it.
install.scope: MCP servers are typically project-scoped (a project's own .mcp.json) since credentials differ per project; some (e.g. a personal Figma/Notion token) may make more sense at user scope — the curator decides.

servers.name: supabase
servers.fires_on: database schema, migrations, RLS policies, edge functions
servers.brain_integration: Schema and migration decisions are distilled to decisions/ ADRs; the live table/policy shape is kept current in a wiki/entities/ page.

servers.name: firebase
servers.fires_on: Firebase auth, Firestore schema, cloud functions, hosting config
servers.brain_integration: Auth/Firestore/functions/hosting decisions are distilled to decisions/ ADRs; the live project shape is kept current in a wiki/entities/ page.
servers.setup_hint: claude mcp add firebase -- npx -y firebase-tools@latest experimental:mcp

servers.name: figma
servers.fires_on: UI / design-system work referencing a Figma file
servers.brain_integration: Design-system decisions pulled from Figma are filed to decisions/ ADRs — the same folder frontend-design and ui-ux-pro-max already write to. Figma MCP reads the design; those plugins still own implementation decisions.
servers.precedence: Figma MCP supplies design context; frontend-design/ui-ux-pro-max still decide and execute the build (same precedence as P6.5).

servers.name: framer
servers.fires_on: design / prototype / publish work in Framer
servers.brain_integration: Design decisions are filed to decisions/ ADRs; the live design system is kept current in a wiki/entities/ page.

servers.name: vercel
servers.fires_on: deploy config, env vars, domains, build/runtime status
servers.brain_integration: Deploy config decisions (env vars, domains, build settings) are filed to decisions/ ADRs; live deployment/build status is kept on the workstream's projects/ page.
